data.reason_zh: 摘要描述了外部机器人 harness 的持久工作区：编码智能体编写程序、根据模拟器反馈修复，并复用笔记与可执行技能，在十轮重复任务子集上提升成功率。

scope_support.feedback_quote: Persistent workspace evolution uses simulator feedback to improve success over ten passes through recurring 100-task subsets.
scope_support.object_quote: a unified robot harness, agents read sensor data, write and execute programs, inspect recorded outcomes, repair failures, and reuse notes and executable skills
scope_support.persistence_quote: reuse notes and executable skills while keeping their model weights fixed
